summary: Tested new payroll components (Tj. Jabatan/Transport/Lain-lain) + Loan tracking end-to-end. 10/10 backend pytest cases PASS covering schema, calculation (gross=18.9M, BPJS base excludes transport, JHT=370k, BPJS Kes=120k capped), loan deduction, auto-stop when tenor_paid>=total, auto-increment on run, rollback on delete-run, rollback on re-run, PDF generation, and backwards compat. Frontend Employee Add modal has all 6 new data-testids (emp-tj-jabatan, emp-tj-transport, emp-tj-lainnya, emp-loan-installment, emp-loan-tenor-total, emp-loan-tenor-paid) with proper Indonesian labels and helper text ('Masuk base BPJS & PPh21', 'Non-taxable benefit', 'Auto-increment saat payroll'). Siti Aminah data preserved with expected values (gross=18,900,000; net=16,436,914.50; loan=500,000).
action_items: Existing payroll runs (2026-06, 2026-01, 2025-11) were generated BEFORE new components were added, so their payslips do NOT show the new rows. This is expected because Payslip display is conditional (only shows if value > 0). To verify UI display of new rows, main agent should run payroll for a NEW period (e.g. 2026-04 or 2026-07) — Siti Aminah's slip will then show Tj. Jabatan (500k), Tj. Transport (300k), Tj. Lain-lain (100k), and Angsuran Pinjaman (500k) rows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 2960+ lines — still monolithic; splitting into routers remains a maintainability improvement.
Loan rollback logic (server.py:1007-1013 & 1101-1109) correctly decrements loan_tenor_paid based on loan_info.active recorded in stored slip — robust against config changes between runs.

calculate_payslip loan_info.tenor_paid_after computed for preview even when loan_active is false uses `loan_tenor_paid` directly (line 371) — correct. remaining_after=0 when tenor_total==0 (unlimited) is a slight information loss but acceptable given design.
EmployeeIn defaults for new fields all default to 0 → backwards compat verified.
BPJS/JHT/JP/PPh21 correctly exclude tunjangan_transport & tunjangan_lainnya from taxable base (line 296-298, 302, 309-310, 320) — matches user choice 2=b.
PDF payslip conditionally renders new rows only when value > 0 (line 1179-1184, 1198) — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Test employees created with TEST_/UI_ prefixed NIKs are cleaned up in test teardown. Siti Aminah (57679bfb-...) state snapshot+restored via module-scoped fixture. 2099-04/05/06/07 payroll runs created & deleted per test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payroll component features complete & verified. New Employee fields: tunjangan_jabatan/transport/lainnya, loan_installment/tenor_total/tenor_paid. Payslip earnings block now returns tunjangan_jabatan/transport/lainnya; deductions.loan present; loan_info block with active/tenor_paid_before/after/remaining_after. Loan auto-increments on POST /payroll/run and rolls back on DELETE /payroll/runs/{period} or on re-run (delete-then-re-insert). Frontend Employees.jsx modal has data-testid'd inputs for all 6 new fields. Payslip.jsx & Portal.jsx render new rows conditionally when value > 0. Existing pre-feature runs (2026-06 etc) won't display new rows — that's by design.
